title: Factors Affecting Intensive Aflibercept Treatment Response in Diabetic Macular Edema: A Real-World Study
condition: Diabetic macular edema (NPDR or PDR) eligible under the Korean insurance criteria (baseline CRT at or above 300 um, HbA1c below 8.0%); 30 eyes of 23 patients; retrospective consecutive cohort, Asan Medical Center, Seoul, 2020-2022; 8 treatment-naive eyes and 22 eyes previously treated (vitrectomy and PRP, bevacizumab with or without PRP, or PRP only)

groups.description: Whole cohort: five monthly loading injections (baseline and months 1-4), then monthly visits with PRN retreatment; PRN retreatment could be switched to bevacizumab, dexamethasone implant or sub-Tenon triamcinolone

series.notes: Mean +/- SD over the whole cohort (Table 2 caption 'whole cohort'); monthly visits counted from the first injection; per-visit n not reported; handling of missed visits not stated; Methods exclude OCT images of poor quality or with artifacts from analysis; values are not stated as removed or replaced after PRN retreatment or switching (first PRN retreatment at month 5; 7 eyes switched to other agents during the maintenance phase)

exclusions.what: Table 2 BCVA rows and p-value rows
exclusions.reason: Visual acuity and p-values are not extracted (brief)

exclusions.what: Table 3 baseline CRT of good versus suboptimal responders
exclusions.reason: Groups defined by CRT after the loading phase (post-baseline outcome); outcome-defined groups are excluded

exclusions.what: Figure 3 CRT curves by DM duration, eGFR, creatinine, potassium and ERM
exclusions.reason: Figure only; no tabulated cells to cite

notes: CRT is defined in Methods 2.3 as the average retinal thickness of the ETDRS central subfield (1 mm diameter), Heidelberg SD-OCT automated measurement: measure central_subfield, device spectralis.
Role control: approved standard agent, no investigational arm.
Table 1 gives baseline characteristics without thickness; Table 3 (responder groups) is not used.
